##1 Load the R package





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(sf, tmap, tidyverse,httr)
```
:::





##2 Import the ACRA data 





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
folder_path <- "data/aspatial/ACRA"
file_list <- list.files(path = folder_path,
                        pattern = "^ACRA*.*\\.csv$",
                        full.names = TRUE)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
acra_data <- file_list %>%
  map_dfr(read_csv)
```
:::




Save the data into rds folder 





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
write_rds(acra_data,
          "data/rds/acra_data.rds")
```
:::
